notes.title: Guardians of Arcadia has a new website, and some new info!
notes.notes:
Hello there!

First of all, thank you for your feedback when the first teaser trailer launched. It was a precious information and help me shape the game in a way that deserves your attention. ːsteamhappyː

I also got some questions and I decided to redesign the website that is more clean, yet useful to the people who wants to get more information about Guardians of Arcadia. It also has a FAQ that contains answers for your most asked questions.

You can see more here: http://www.guardiansofarcadia.com  ːsteammockingː

(as you might see in the website, the UI of the game has changed based on the feedback I got. It still is a WIP but I hope you guys enjoy the evolution from the first version to the final version that is still coming)

On a final note, here's the answer about the structure and price of the game (you can see more in the FAQ file in the website)

[code]Q: How many episodes will be released?
A: Three episodes. Imagine that we are in 1999 and this is a SEGA Dreamcast Game. Episode one is DISC ONE OF A FANTASTIC JOURNEY. 

Q: What is the game price?
A: The first episode will be 9.99 USD. The heroes who buy the first episode will have a discount on future episodes exclusively for supporting us and being so awesome.
[/code]


Cheers.
David

notes.title: Guardians of Arcadia® first trailer is out!
notes.notes:
Guardians of Arcadia® is a indie JRPG made from fans to fans. Our goal is to provide a nostalgic feel on a genre that gently but slowly is getting more attention, mainly due to indie game developers like ourselves.

So let's begin 2017 on the right foot by releasing the First Official Trailer of GUARDIANS OF ARCADIA. You can see it now on our store page!
